spoergsmaal: In what year did Denmark adopt its first constitution?
forklaring: Denmark's first constitution was signed on 5 June 1849.

spoergsmaal: Which Danish king is associated with the Jelling Stones and the Christianisation of Denmark?
forklaring: Harald Bluetooth raised the Great Jelling Stone in the 10th century.

spoergsmaal: In what year were the Danish West Indies transferred to the United States?
forklaring: Denmark sold the islands to the United States in 1917. Today, they are known as the U.S. Virgin Islands.

spoergsmaal: What is the capital of Denmark?
forklaring: Copenhagen is the capital and largest city of Denmark.

spoergsmaal: Which strait lies between Denmark and Sweden near Copenhagen?
forklaring: The Øresund connects the Baltic Sea to the Kattegat and separates Zealand from Scania.

spoergsmaal: What is the capital of New Zealand?
forklaring: Wellington is located at the southern tip of the North Island and is the country's capital.

spoergsmaal: What is the world's largest living animal?
forklaring: The blue whale can grow to over 25 metres long and weigh more than 100 tonnes.

spoergsmaal: Which gas do plants absorb from the air during photosynthesis?
forklaring: Plants use carbon dioxide, water and light energy to produce sugar and oxygen.

spoergsmaal: Which of these mammals lays eggs?
forklaring: The platypus is a monotreme, a small group of mammals that lay eggs.

spoergsmaal: How many players does a football team have on the pitch at the start of a match?
forklaring: A team starts with ten outfield players and one goalkeeper.

spoergsmaal: Which sport is practised in the Tour de France?
forklaring: The Tour de France is a multi-stage road cycling race.

spoergsmaal: How many rings are in the Olympic symbol?
forklaring: The five interlocking rings symbolise the coming together of the continents.

spoergsmaal: Who wrote the Harry Potter books?
forklaring: The British author J.K. Rowling wrote the Harry Potter series.

spoergsmaal: What is the name of the lion in Disney's The Lion King?
forklaring: Simba is the film's main character; Mufasa is his father.

spoergsmaal: Which Danish author wrote the fairy tale The Little Mermaid?
forklaring: Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale The Little Mermaid was published in 1837.

spoergsmaal: What is the chemical formula for water?
forklaring: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

spoergsmaal: Which planet is often called the Red Planet?
forklaring: Iron-rich dust on the surface of Mars gives the planet its reddish colour.

spoergsmaal: Which particle has a negative electric charge?
forklaring: The electron has a negative charge; the proton is positive and the neutron is neutral.

spoergsmaal: What does the French word “bonjour” mean?
forklaring: “Bonjour” is used as a greeting and means hello or good morning.

spoergsmaal: What is the plural form of the English word “child”?
forklaring: “Child” has the irregular plural form “children”.

spoergsmaal: Which writing system does Japanese use, among other things, for foreign words?
forklaring: Japanese uses katakana, among other things, for loanwords and foreign names.

spoergsmaal: What is the main ingredient in hummus?
forklaring: Hummus is typically made from blended chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic.

spoergsmaal: Which country does feta cheese come from?
forklaring: Feta is a Greek cheese with protected designation of origin status.

spoergsmaal: Which type of grain is traditionally used to make couscous?
forklaring: Couscous is traditionally made from semolina derived from durum wheat.

spoergsmaal: Which 1658 peace treaty led Denmark to cede Scania, Blekinge and Halland to Sweden?
forklaring: The Treaty of Roskilde was concluded in 1658 after the Swedes invaded Zealand.

spoergsmaal: Which European capital lies on the Tagus (Tejo) River?
forklaring: The Tagus flows through Spain and Portugal and empties into the sea near Lisbon.

spoergsmaal: What is the process called in which plants release water vapour through their leaves?
forklaring: During transpiration, water evaporates from a plant's leaves, mainly through tiny pores called stomata.

spoergsmaal: Which country won the first FIFA Women's World Cup in 1991?
forklaring: The United States defeated Norway in the final at the 1991 World Cup in China.

spoergsmaal: Who composed the music for Peer Gynt?
forklaring: The Norwegian composer Edvard Grieg wrote the incidental music for Ibsen's Peer Gynt.

spoergsmaal: Which element has atomic number 79?
forklaring: Gold has atomic number 79 and the chemical symbol Au.

spoergsmaal: Which language does the word “Schadenfreude” come from?
forklaring: The German word describes pleasure at someone else's misfortune.

spoergsmaal: Which spice traditionally gives Swedish saffron buns their golden colour?
forklaring: Saffron gives lussekatter their characteristic yellow colour.

spoergsmaal: Who raised the Great Jelling Stone?
forklaring: Around 965, Harald raised the stone in memory of his parents, Gorm and Thyra, and to proclaim that he had made the Danes Christian.

spoergsmaal: In what year was Denmark's Constitution signed?
forklaring: Frederick VII signed the Constitution on 5 June 1849, ending absolute monarchy and establishing a constitutional monarchy in Denmark.

spoergsmaal: The Danish West Indies were transferred from Denmark to the United States in 1917.
forklaring: The transfer took place on 31 March 1917. The islands are now called the U.S. Virgin Islands.

spoergsmaal: Which king introduced absolute monarchy in Denmark in 1660?
forklaring: After the wars against Sweden, Frederick III established hereditary absolute monarchy in 1660. The King's Law of 1665 later consolidated it.

spoergsmaal: In what year did the Battle of Copenhagen take place?
forklaring: On 2 April 1801, a British fleet led in part by Horatio Nelson attacked the Danish fleet off Copenhagen.

spoergsmaal: What is the largest island in Denmark proper (excluding Greenland and the Faroe Islands)?
forklaring: Zealand covers just over 7,000 km², almost twice the size of Funen.

spoergsmaal: Greenland is the world's largest island.
forklaring: Australia is larger, but it is considered a continent, making Greenland the world's largest island.

spoergsmaal: What is the capital of Australia?
forklaring: Canberra was built as a compromise because both Sydney and Melbourne wanted to be the capital.

spoergsmaal: What is the highest natural point in Denmark?
forklaring: Møllehøj is 170.86 metres high, only a few centimetres higher than the natural ground at Yding Skovhøj.

spoergsmaal: What is Denmark's longest river?
forklaring: The Gudenå is about 160 km long, flowing from Tinnet Krat near Tørring to Randers Fjord.

spoergsmaal: How many legs does a spider have?
forklaring: Spiders are arachnids, not insects. Insects have six legs.

spoergsmaal: Which bird is Denmark's national bird?
forklaring: The mute swan was chosen as Denmark's national bird in 1984, a fitting choice for the country that gave us The Ugly Duckling.

spoergsmaal: Whales are mammals.
forklaring: Whales breathe with lungs, give birth to live young and nurse them.

spoergsmaal: How many hearts does an octopus have?
forklaring: Two hearts pump blood through the gills, while the third pumps it around the rest of the body.

spoergsmaal: What are the small, transparent eels that arrive at the coasts from the sea called?
forklaring: Glass eels have drifted on ocean currents from the Sargasso Sea. Smolts, by contrast, are young salmon heading out to sea.

spoergsmaal: In what year did Denmark's men's national football team win the European Championship?
forklaring: Denmark qualified at the last moment after Yugoslavia was excluded, then beat Germany 2–0 in the final.

spoergsmaal: A marathon is about 42 kilometres long.
forklaring: The exact distance is 42.195 km, set at the 1908 London Olympics.

spoergsmaal: Which Danish cyclist won the Tour de France in 2022?
forklaring: Vingegaard won again in 2023. The Tour also started in Denmark in 2022.

spoergsmaal: What is the highest score you can get with three darts in darts?
forklaring: Three darts in triple 20 score 3 × 60 = 180.

spoergsmaal: What is the name of the leader of the Olsen Gang?
forklaring: Ove Sprogøe played Egon in all 14 Danish Olsen Gang films.

spoergsmaal: Which Danish group was behind the hit “Barbie Girl”?
forklaring: Released in 1997, the song topped charts in many countries and made Aqua famous around the world.

spoergsmaal: H.C. Andersen wrote the fairy tale “The Little Mermaid”.
forklaring: The fairy tale was published in 1837. The statue on Langelinie was unveiled in 1913.

spoergsmaal: Which duo won Eurovision for Denmark in 2000?
forklaring: Brothers Jørgen and Niels Olsen won with “Fly on the Wings of Love”.

spoergsmaal: Who directed the 2012 film The Hunt (Jagten)?
forklaring: Mads Mikkelsen won the Best Actor award at Cannes for the leading role.

spoergsmaal: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
forklaring: Mercury is also the smallest planet in the Solar System.

spoergsmaal: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
forklaring: Au comes from the Latin word aurum. Ag is the symbol for silver.

spoergsmaal: Sound travels faster than light.
forklaring: Light travels almost a million times faster, which is why you see lightning before you hear thunder.

spoergsmaal: Which Danish physicist won the 1922 Nobel Prize for his work on the structure of the atom?
forklaring: Bohr received the prize for his atomic model. His son Aage Bohr won the Nobel Prize himself in 1975.

spoergsmaal: Which chemical element has the symbol W?
forklaring: The symbol comes from wolfram, another name for tungsten. Bismuth has the symbol Bi.

spoergsmaal: Which language is the main language spoken in Brazil?
forklaring: Brazil was a Portuguese colony and is now the world's largest Portuguese-speaking country.

spoergsmaal: What is the title of Denmark's national anthem for civic occasions?
korrekt: Der er et yndigt land (There Is a Lovely Land)
forkerte: Kong Christian stod ved højen mast
forklaring: The lyrics were written by Adam Oehlenschläger. “Kong Christian” is Denmark's royal anthem.

spoergsmaal: How many letters are there in the Danish alphabet?
forklaring: The 26 Latin letters plus æ, ø and å.

spoergsmaal: The word “hygge” has been included in the Oxford English Dictionary.
forklaring: It was added in 2017 following a wave of books about Danish hygge published abroad.

spoergsmaal: Who wrote the 1843 work Either/Or (Enten – Eller)?
forklaring: Kierkegaard published it under the pseudonym Victor Eremita.

spoergsmaal: What is the main ingredient in guacamole?
forklaring: Guacamole originated in Mexico, where the Aztecs made an early version of it.

spoergsmaal: Which country did pizza originally come from?
forklaring: The classic Margherita is associated with Naples in the late 19th century.

spoergsmaal: Sparkling wine can only be called Champagne if it is made in the Champagne region of France.
forklaring: The name is a protected designation of origin.

spoergsmaal: What is rum made from?
forklaring: Rum is distilled from sugar cane juice or molasses. Agave is used to make tequila.

spoergsmaal: Which dish was named Denmark's national dish in 2014?
forklaring: The dish won a public vote organised by the Danish Ministry of Food.

spoergsmaal: What is the capital of Norway?
forklaring: Oslo was called Christiania from 1624 to 1925, after King Christian IV.

spoergsmaal: Which sea lies off the west coast of Jutland?
forklaring: The North Sea is known for its rough weather and the long sandy beaches along Jutland's west coast.

spoergsmaal: What is the world's largest ocean?
forklaring: The Pacific Ocean covers about one third of Earth's surface.

spoergsmaal: Mount Everest is the world's highest mountain when measured from sea level.
forklaring: Everest is about 8,849 metres high and lies on the border between Nepal and China.

spoergsmaal: What is Denmark's largest lake?
forklaring: Arresø in North Zealand covers about 40 km². Furesø, by contrast, is the deepest lake.

spoergsmaal: Which city is connected to Nørresundby by the Limfjord Bridge?
forklaring: The Limfjord Bridge opened in 1933. It is a bascule bridge that can be raised to let ships pass.

spoergsmaal: Which Nordic country has the largest population?
forklaring: Sweden has more than 10 million inhabitants, almost twice as many as Denmark.

spoergsmaal: What is the capital of Canada?
forklaring: Ottawa was chosen in 1857, partly because it lay between English-speaking and French-speaking Canada.

spoergsmaal: Which river flows through Paris?
forklaring: The Seine flows into the English Channel near Le Havre.

spoergsmaal: Bornholm is in the Baltic Sea.
forklaring: Bornholm is closer to Sweden than to the rest of Denmark.

spoergsmaal: What is the capital of the Faroe Islands?
forklaring: Tórshavn means “Thor's harbour” and is one of the world's smallest capitals.

spoergsmaal: What is the capital of Greenland?
forklaring: Nuuk was formerly called Godthåb and was founded by the missionary Hans Egede in 1728.

spoergsmaal: Which island group contains Denmark's easternmost point?
forklaring: The Ertholmene islands, including Christiansø, lie northeast of Bornholm. The easternmost island is Græsholm.

spoergsmaal: What is the northernmost point of Denmark called?
forklaring: At Grenen, you can stand with one foot in the Skagerrak and the other in the Kattegat.

spoergsmaal: Which country is the world's largest by area?
forklaring: Russia spans 11 time zones.

spoergsmaal: What is the world's largest hot desert?
forklaring: If cold deserts are included, Antarctica is actually the world's largest desert.

spoergsmaal: What is the capital of Switzerland?
forklaring: Switzerland has no official capital, but Bern is the seat of government and is called the “federal city”.

spoergsmaal: What is Europe's longest river?
forklaring: The Volga is about 3,500 km long and flows into the Caspian Sea.

spoergsmaal: Iceland is a member of the EU.
forklaring: Iceland is part of the EEA and the Schengen Area, but not the EU.

spoergsmaal: How many administrative regions is Denmark divided into?
forklaring: The five regions were established in the 2007 municipal reform, replacing 13 counties.

spoergsmaal: What is the body of water between Funen and Jutland called?
forklaring: The Little Belt is crossed by both the Old Little Belt Bridge, built in 1935, and the New Little Belt Bridge, built in 1970.

spoergsmaal: What is the world's deepest lake?
forklaring: Lake Baikal in Siberia is more than 1,600 metres deep and contains about one fifth of the world's lake freshwater.

spoergsmaal: What is the capital of Turkey?
forklaring: Ankara became the capital in 1923, although Istanbul is by far the largest city.

spoergsmaal: Which canal connects the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea?
forklaring: The Suez Canal opened in 1869, saving ships the journey around southern Africa.

spoergsmaal: What is Africa's highest mountain?
forklaring: Kilimanjaro in Tanzania is a dormant volcano almost 5,900 metres high.

spoergsmaal: How many countries share a land border with Denmark?
forklaring: Denmark's only land border is with Germany in Southern Jutland.

spoergsmaal: What is the capital of Brazil?
forklaring: Brasília was built from scratch and inaugurated as the capital in 1960.

spoergsmaal: What is Denmark's second-largest city?
forklaring: Aarhus has more than 300,000 inhabitants in the city proper.

spoergsmaal: What is the highest point on Bornholm called?
forklaring: Rytterknægten is in Almindingen and is about 162 metres high, with an observation tower at the top.

spoergsmaal: Which country has Ulaanbaatar as its capital?
forklaring: Ulaanbaatar is considered the world's coldest capital based on its average annual temperature.

spoergsmaal: Which country occupied Denmark on 9 April 1940?
forklaring: The occupation lasted five years, until German troops in Denmark surrendered in May 1945.

spoergsmaal: What do we call the Scandinavian seafarers who raided and traded across Europe around 800–1050?
forklaring: The Viking Age is often dated from the raid on the monastery at Lindisfarne in 793.

spoergsmaal: The German surrender in Denmark took effect on 5 May 1945.
forklaring: The news of liberation was broadcast on the evening of 4 May, which is why many people put candles in their windows that evening.

spoergsmaal: In what year was Southern Jutland reunited with Denmark?
forklaring: Reunification followed a referendum in Schleswig after the First World War.

spoergsmaal: Who was king of Denmark during the German occupation from 1940 to 1945?
forklaring: Christian X became a symbol of national unity through his daily horseback rides through Copenhagen.

spoergsmaal: Which city was the kings' main residence before Copenhagen took over that role in the 15th century?
forklaring: Roskilde Cathedral is still the burial church of Danish kings and queens.

spoergsmaal: Which queen united Denmark, Norway and Sweden in the Kalmar Union in 1397?
forklaring: Margaret had her great-nephew Eric of Pomerania crowned king of all three realms.

spoergsmaal: Christian IV had the Round Tower built.
forklaring: The tower was built from 1637 to 1642 as an observatory. Visitors reach the top by a spiral ramp rather than stairs.

spoergsmaal: In what year was the Reformation carried out in Denmark?
forklaring: Christian III made Denmark Lutheran, and the Church's lands and property passed to the Crown.

spoergsmaal: In what year did the Berlin Wall fall?
forklaring: The Wall fell on 9 November 1989, and Germany was reunified the following year.

spoergsmaal: Which passenger ship sank on its maiden voyage in April 1912?
forklaring: The Titanic struck an iceberg in the North Atlantic, and more than 1,500 people died.

spoergsmaal: Who was the first president of the United States?
forklaring: Washington took office in 1789, and the capital, Washington, D.C., is named after him.

spoergsmaal: In what year did the First World War begin?
forklaring: The war was triggered by the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria in Sarajevo.

spoergsmaal: Which French emperor was finally defeated at Waterloo in 1815?
forklaring: After Waterloo, Napoleon was exiled to the small island of Saint Helena in the South Atlantic.

spoergsmaal: Which Egyptian pharaoh was found in an almost undisturbed tomb in 1922?
forklaring: Howard Carter discovered the tomb in the Valley of the Kings. It was full of treasures, including the famous gold mask.

spoergsmaal: Which Roman city was buried in ash when Mount Vesuvius erupted in AD 79?
forklaring: The ash preserved the city so well that visitors can still walk through its streets and houses today.

spoergsmaal: In what year did Danish women gain the right to vote in elections to the Folketing?
forklaring: The constitutional amendment of 1915 gave women and servants the right to vote. Women had been allowed to vote in local elections since 1908.

spoergsmaal: What was the name of the Danish resistance movement's supreme council from 1943?
forklaring: The Freedom Council was formed in September 1943 to unite the various resistance groups.

spoergsmaal: In what year did the second Christiansborg Palace burn down?
forklaring: The first Christiansborg burned down in 1794 and the second in 1884. The current palace was completed in 1928.

spoergsmaal: Denmark sold its colony of Tranquebar in India to Great Britain in 1845.
forklaring: Tranquebar had been a Danish trading post for more than 200 years, and Fort Dansborg still stands there.

spoergsmaal: What is the period in the first half of the 19th century, when Danish art and literature flourished, called?
forklaring: Notable figures of the Danish Golden Age include H.C. Andersen, Kierkegaard, Thorvaldsen and the painter Eckersberg.

spoergsmaal: Which prime minister was dismissed by King Christian X during the Easter Crisis of 1920?
forklaring: The dismissal led to demonstrations and the threat of a general strike. It was the last time a Danish king dismissed a government.

spoergsmaal: Who became Denmark's first Social Democratic prime minister in 1924?
forklaring: Stauning served as prime minister on several occasions until his death in 1942.

spoergsmaal: In what year did Denmark join the European Communities (now the EU)?
forklaring: The referendum was held in 1972, but membership took effect on 1 January 1973.

spoergsmaal: What was the name of the German royal physician who effectively ruled Denmark from 1770 to 1772?
forklaring: Struensee introduced many reforms but was overthrown and executed in 1772 after his affair with Queen Caroline Matilda.

spoergsmaal: What was the name of the Vikings' god of thunder?
forklaring: Thor wielded the hammer Mjölnir, and Thursday is named after him.

spoergsmaal: Christian IV was king for more than 50 years.
forklaring: He was king from 1588 to 1648, a total of 60 years—the longest reign of a Danish monarch before Margrethe II.

spoergsmaal: What is the name of the Swedes' failed attack on Copenhagen on the night of 11 February 1659?
forklaring: The people of Copenhagen repelled the attack, and the city was later granted privileges in recognition of its defence.

spoergsmaal: Which king lost Scania, Halland and Blekinge in the Treaty of Roskilde in 1658?
forklaring: The loss of the Scanian provinces was one of the greatest territorial losses in Danish history.

spoergsmaal: Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
forklaring: Armstrong set foot on the Moon on 21 July 1969 (Danish time) during Apollo 11.

spoergsmaal: Which fruit is cider made from?
forklaring: When the drink is made from pears, it is called perry.

spoergsmaal: Which country does sushi come from?
forklaring: Sushi literally refers to vinegared rice; fish is not essential.

spoergsmaal: Botanically speaking, a tomato is a fruit.
forklaring: Botanically, a fruit is the part of a plant that contains its seeds. Cucumbers and peppers are fruits too.

spoergsmaal: Which grain is used to brew most beer?
forklaring: Barley is first malted so its starch can be converted into sugar for the yeast to ferment.

spoergsmaal: What is the name of the Italian dessert made with mascarpone, coffee and cocoa?
forklaring: Tiramisu means “pick me up”.

spoergsmaal: Which nut is the main ingredient in marzipan?
forklaring: Marzipan is made from almonds and sugar.

spoergsmaal: What is the name of the Danish Christmas dessert made with rice, whipped cream and chopped almonds?
forklaring: The name comes from the French “riz à l'amande”, meaning rice with almonds.

spoergsmaal: Gin is flavoured with juniper berries.
forklaring: Juniper is the only botanical that must be used for a spirit to be called gin.

spoergsmaal: Which country does paella come from?
forklaring: Paella originated in the area around Valencia.

spoergsmaal: What is French sparkling wine made using the Champagne method, but outside Champagne, called?
forklaring: Cava is Spanish, Prosecco is Italian and Sekt is German.

spoergsmaal: Which spirit is made from agave?
forklaring: Authentic tequila must be made from blue agave in designated areas of Mexico.

spoergsmaal: What is calvados mainly made from?
forklaring: Calvados is apple brandy from Normandy. A small amount of pears may also be used.

spoergsmaal: What is the name of the classic Danish blue cheese?
forklaring: Danablu was developed in the early 20th century as a Danish alternative to Roquefort.

spoergsmaal: What is whisky made from malted barley at a single distillery called?
forklaring: Blended whisky combines whisky from several distilleries.

spoergsmaal: Which spice is the world's most expensive by weight?
forklaring: Saffron consists of crocus stigmas picked by hand. It takes about 150,000 flowers to produce one kilogram.

spoergsmaal: Bourbon must be made from at least 51% corn.
forklaring: Bourbon must also be aged in new charred oak barrels.

spoergsmaal: Which country does kimchi come from?
forklaring: Kimchi is fermented vegetables, most often napa cabbage with chilli.

spoergsmaal: What is beer fermented at low temperatures with bottom-fermenting yeast called?
forklaring: Pilsner is the best-known type of lager. Ale, stout and porter are top-fermented.

spoergsmaal: Which country is the world's largest coffee producer?
forklaring: Brazil produces about one third of the world's coffee. Ethiopia is considered the birthplace of coffee.

spoergsmaal: Which grape variety is grown most widely in Bordeaux?
forklaring: Merlot dominates on the Right Bank, while Cabernet Sauvignon is stronger on the Left Bank.

spoergsmaal: What is Japanese rice wine called?
forklaring: Soju is Korean, while shochu and baijiu are spirits rather than wines.

spoergsmaal: What does IPA stand for in the world of beer?
forklaring: This hop-forward style became popular in the 19th century, when beer was shipped from England to India.

spoergsmaal: Which flour is the most important ingredient in Danish rye bread?
forklaring: Danish rye bread is traditionally leavened with sourdough.

spoergsmaal: Which vegetable gives borscht its red colour?
forklaring: Borscht is popular across Eastern Europe, especially in Ukraine, Russia and Poland.

spoergsmaal: Which country do Gouda and Edam cheeses come from?
forklaring: Both cheeses are named after towns in the Netherlands.

spoergsmaal: Which fortified wine comes from Portugal's Douro Valley?
forklaring: Sherry is Spanish, Marsala comes from Sicily, and vermouth is a flavoured wine.

spoergsmaal: What is an espresso topped with a small amount of milk foam called?
forklaring: Macchiato means “stained” in Italian: the coffee is stained with milk.

spoergsmaal: Which country does Scotch whisky come from?
forklaring: To be called Scotch, the whisky must be aged in casks in Scotland for at least three years.

spoergsmaal: Which fruit is the main ingredient in a classic tarte Tatin?
forklaring: Tarte Tatin is an upside-down apple tart in which the apples are caramelised in the bottom of the pan.

spoergsmaal: What is a young frog called before it grows legs?
forklaring: Tadpoles live in water and breathe through gills until they transform into frogs.

spoergsmaal: What is the world's largest land animal?
forklaring: An African elephant bull can weigh more than six tonnes.

spoergsmaal: What does a giant panda eat most of?
forklaring: A panda can spend 10 to 16 hours a day eating bamboo.

spoergsmaal: Penguins can fly.
forklaring: Penguins cannot fly through the air, but they use their wings as flippers and are excellent swimmers.

spoergsmaal: What is the world's fastest land animal?
forklaring: A cheetah can run at about 100 km/h, but only in short bursts.

spoergsmaal: What is Denmark's largest bird of prey?
forklaring: The white-tailed eagle has a wingspan of more than two metres and returned to breed in Denmark in the 1990s.

spoergsmaal: What is Denmark's only venomous snake called?
forklaring: The slow worm is not a snake at all, but a legless lizard.

spoergsmaal: A bat is a bird.
forklaring: Bats are mammals—the only mammals capable of true powered flight.

spoergsmaal: How many arms does a typical starfish have?
forklaring: If a starfish loses an arm, it can grow a new one.

spoergsmaal: What is a roe deer's young called?
forklaring: Roe deer fawns have white spots during their first few months, which camouflage them on the forest floor.

spoergsmaal: Which tree produces acorns?
forklaring: Beech trees, by contrast, produce beechnuts, which are small triangular nuts.

spoergsmaal: What do you call an animal that eats both plants and meat?
forklaring: Humans, bears and badgers are examples of omnivores.

spoergsmaal: Which bird lays its eggs in the nests of other birds?
forklaring: A cuckoo chick often pushes the host bird's own eggs or chicks out of the nest.

spoergsmaal: What is the world's largest fish?
forklaring: The whale shark can grow to more than 12 metres long, but feeds on plankton. The basking shark is second-largest.

spoergsmaal: How long is an elephant's gestation period, approximately?
forklaring: Elephants have the longest gestation period of any land mammal.

spoergsmaal: Sharks have a skeleton made of cartilage rather than bone.
forklaring: Cartilage is lighter and more flexible than bone. It is the same type of tissue found in our ears and noses.

spoergsmaal: What is the largest marsupial?
forklaring: A large male can reach about 1.8 metres tall when standing upright.

spoergsmaal: What is the transformation from a caterpillar into a butterfly called?
forklaring: During metamorphosis inside the chrysalis, the caterpillar's body is almost completely reorganised.

spoergsmaal: Which part of a plant absorbs water from the soil?
